newsitem.title: USA: RailTex Inc July carloadings up by 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: RailTex Inc July carloadings up by 40 pct.

text.p: RailTex Inc said Tuesday its July 1997 carloadings increased 40 percent to 39,722 from 28,394 in July 1996.
On a "same railroad" basis, carloadings increased 12 percent to 31,682 in July 1997 from 28,394 in July 1996, the company said.

RailTex said it posted "same railroad" traffic gains in coal, lumber, metals, farm products and chemicals. The gains, said the company, were partially offset by decreased traffic levels for minerals and stone and other products.

Year-to-date July 1997 carloadings increased 33 percent to 271,662 from 204,528 in the prior year period. "Same railroad" carloadings increased four percent to 208,479 from 201,074 in the prior year period.
RailTex is a short line railroad, providing freight service over about 3,800 miles of track in the United States, Canada and Mexico and has equity interests in two Brazilian lines.
